properties.name: Terra Arabica
properties.principle: The Arabian plate's land and seas to the continental margin: the peninsula, the Levant east of Suez with Sinai, Mesopotamia and the Persian Gulf, ending at the Zagros and Bitlis mountain front (ZR20) and the Red Sea's and the Gulf of Aden's axes (ZR19).
